privateHome.gate.en: This feature needs reviewed server access and secure recovery storage.
privateHome.gate.zh-Hans: 此功能需要审核后的服务访问权限和安全恢复存储。

privateHome.boundary.en: Only you can manage this private location in the app. It is never a public map place, NPC memory, or merchant ownership claim.
privateHome.boundary.zh-Hans: 仅你可以在 App 中管理此私人位置。它不是公开地图地点、NPC 记忆或商家产权声明。

privateHome.issue.en: Unable to confirm this operation. Keep any pending request and use exact retry.
privateHome.issue.zh-Hans: 无法确认此操作。请保留待处理请求并原样重试。

privateHome.datum.en: Enter WGS84 coordinates, up to six decimal places. No device location is requested.
privateHome.datum.zh-Hans: 输入 WGS84 坐标，最多六位小数。不请求设备定位。

privateHome.setPurpose.en: Save this location privately for your current account? Server placement rules and cooldowns still apply.
privateHome.setPurpose.zh-Hans: 是否为当前账户私下保存此位置？仍须遵守服务器位置规则和冷却时间。

privateHome.deletePurpose.en: Delete your current private home and its stored coordinates?
privateHome.deletePurpose.zh-Hans: 是否删除当前私人家园及其已存坐标？

privateHome.unknownPurpose.en: The result is unknown. Refresh cannot settle it. Retry the identical saved request; do not start a new change.
privateHome.unknownPurpose.zh-Hans: 结果未知。刷新无法确认结果。请原样重试已保存的请求，不要发起新的变更。

privateHome.decision.SAVED.en: Saved. Confirm the refreshed state below.
privateHome.decision.SAVED.zh-Hans: 已保存，请确认下方刷新状态。

privateHome.decision.DELETED.en: Deleted. Confirm the refreshed state below.
privateHome.decision.DELETED.zh-Hans: 已删除，请确认下方刷新状态。

privateHome.decision.VERSION_CONFLICT.en: Home changed elsewhere. Refresh and review again.
privateHome.decision.VERSION_CONFLICT.zh-Hans: 家园已在其他地方变更，请刷新后重新审核。

privateHome.decision.HOME_CHANGE_COOLDOW.en: Home changes are temporarily on cooldown.

privateHome.gamePoint.en: Choose a safe point for your game home. It need not be your real residence. Saving a point does not verify safety, ownership, or permission to enter.
privateHome.gamePoint.zh-Hans: 为游戏家园选择安全的地点，不必是真实住址。保存地点不代表已验证安全性、产权或进入许可。

privateHome.map.noLocation.en: No device location or background tracking is used. Nothing is saved until you review and confirm the private change.
privateHome.map.noLocation.zh-Hans: 不使用设备定位或后台追踪。审核并确认私人变更后才会保存。

privateHome.map.issue.providerUnverified.en: Map selection is unavailable: this provider’s coordinate datum and regional rendering have not been verified for private home. Use manual WGS84 entry instead.
privateHome.map.issue.providerUnverified.zh-Hans: 地图选点不可用：尚未验证此提供方用于私人家园的坐标基准及地区地图显示。请改用手动输入 WGS84 坐标。

privateHome.map.issue.datumUnsupported.en: This point is not verified WGS84. No coordinate conversion is performed; it cannot be saved.
privateHome.map.issue.datumUnsupported.zh-Hans: 此点未被验证为 WGS84，不会进行坐标转换，因此无法保存。

privateHome.map.issue.coordinateInvalid.en: This point has invalid coordinates. Select another point or enter WGS84 coordinates manually.
privateHome.map.issue.coordinateInvalid.zh-Hans: 此点坐标无效，请选择其他点或手动输入 WGS84 坐标。

privateHome.map.issue.precisionUnsupport.en: This source point exceeds six decimal places. It has not been rounded or saved. Enter your intended WGS84 point manually with at most six decimal places.
privateHome.map.issue.precisionUnsupport.zh-Hans: 来源坐标超过六位小数，未作舍入，也未保存。请手动输入你要选择的 WGS84 坐标，最多六位小数。

privateHome.map.synthetic.zh-Hans: 模拟测试点（无地图网络请求）

privateHome.map.exact.en: Exact save coordinates: latitude, longitude · WGS84 · up to six decimal places.
privateHome.map.exact.zh-Hans: 确切保存坐标：纬度、经度 · WGS84 · 最多六位小数。

privateHome.map.manual.zh-Hans: 手动输入 WGS84 坐标
